ResearchProjectDef.label: portion planning
ResearchProjectDef.description: Prepare larger portions on ordinary stoves. They require proportionally more ingredients, cooking work, and storage space, but help feed pawns with greater appetites.

ResearchProjectDef.label: colossal meals
ResearchProjectDef.description: Prepare exceptionally large meals for specialized diets. Their ingredient, labor, and storage costs scale with the portion.

ResearchProjectDef.label: UltraTech cooking
ResearchProjectDef.description: Analyse and learn to construct cooking stations on par with glitterworld societies, capable of cooking foods containing caloric density beyond normal human comprehension.

ResearchProjectDef.label: cooking module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build a module for the ultratech cooking station that allows it to operate at higher efficiency, greatly increasing the speed at which food is created.

ResearchProjectDef.label: glutonium enriched foods
ResearchProjectDef.description: Prepare enriched foods from ordinary food and calorite milk or meat. Ingredient energy, work, storage and whole-item waste all matter.

ResearchProjectDef.label: glutonium meals
ResearchProjectDef.description: Fantasy only: manufacture exceptionally concentrated pure-gluttonium meals. Individual food permissions and useful-intake limits still apply.

ResearchProjectDef.label: project α
ResearchProjectDef.description: Fantasy only: compress 30 gluttonium into an extremely energy-dense Alpha ball. Individual food permissions and useful-intake limits still apply.

ResearchProjectDef.label: project Ω
ResearchProjectDef.description: Fantasy only: manufacture an Omega ball independently from 100 gluttonium. Alpha research is a prerequisite, but the recipe does not consume an Alpha ball.

ResearchProjectDef.label: glutonium
ResearchProjectDef.description: Learn to process a specialist industrial reagent into enriched ingredients and metabolic drugs. Gluttonium is not edible raw and is not a general crafting material.

ResearchProjectDef.label: glutonium drugs
ResearchProjectDef.description: Synthesize drugs and addictive substances infused or laced with gluttonium.

ResearchProjectDef.label: experimental drugs
ResearchProjectDef.description: Fantasy only: synthesize Swell-Glow X and MAX after mastering ordinary metabolic drugs. These extreme doses require enough capacity for the entire dose.

ResearchProjectDef.label: glutonium fabrication
ResearchProjectDef.description: Synthesize gluttonium from steel and chemfuel using a powered industrial fabricator. Every batch consumes inputs. A separate power-only bill is available in Fantasy mode.

ResearchProjectDef.label: zenith orb
ResearchProjectDef.description: Create an orb that radiates pure gluttonium that can be attuned to specific pawns, causing weight gain on an inconceivable level.
